# Check if maggs magnificent mild is the most decorated beer between 1995 and 2009
# First, filter the dataframe for the given year range
df_filtered = df[(df['year'] >= 1995) & (df['year'] <= 2009)]

# Count the number of prizes for each beer in this period
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Get the beer with the maximum count
most_decorated_beer = prize_counts.idxmax() if not prize_counts.empty else None

# Check if it is maggs magnificent mild
answer = (most_decorated_beer == "maggs magnificent mild")
